description: Rooftop cell at night (goal.md AD-2): neon, the bay skyline, the fan. Marble text prompt (+ key art once approved) → spz 100k/500k/full + collider + pano + cell.json.

inputs.text: Standing on a flat tar-and-gravel rooftop at night in the Bay Area. A low parapet wall, HVAC units, a rooftop water tank, satellite dishes, a rooftop party corner with folding chairs, a cooler and string lights; a large neon sign on the neighboring building throws pink and cyan light across the roof; beyond the parapet the bay, the city skyline and distant bridge lights glow through a fog bank. Photorealistic, physically plausible night light with neon reflections on wet gravel, melancholy and beautiful. No people, no cars.
